market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed higher, with business articles indicating that a surprising jobs report last week contributed to market action, alongside performance from companies like Nvidia and Micron. The jobs market reportedly shows slower hiring, which can influence investor sentiment.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased slightly. While a recent jobs report indicated slower hiring, which might typically ease yield pressure, the provided articles do not offer a specific reason for this particular day's increase in yields.

vix.why: The VIX decreased, aligning with the rise in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite. The articles do not explicitly state a reason for the VIX movement.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased over the past week. This change follows the direction of the 10-year Treasury yield, which also saw an increase. High interest rates are making home remodeling expensive and impacting home affordability for many Americans.

policy.what_happened: This document contains proposed regulations regarding employer contributions to Trump accounts and nondiscrimination rules for dependent care assistance programs.
policy.effect: Employer contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance and nondiscrimination rules.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document contains proposed regulations regarding employer contributions to Trump accounts and nondiscrimination rules for dependent care assistance programs.
policy_week.effect: Employer contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance and nondiscrimination rules.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations provide general requirements for Trump accounts, their establishment, and qualified general contributions.
policy_week.effect: You would be affected by new requirements for establishing Trump accounts and making qualified contributions to them.

policy_week.what_happened: Temporary regulations establish general requirements for Trump accounts, including automatic enrollment by the Secretary of the Treasury.
policy_week.effect: You have automatic enrollment in a Trump account.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance for employer contributions to Trump accounts.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to a Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on eligible investments for Trump accounts.
policy_week.effect: You would have an obligation to only invest Trump account funds in eligible investments.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

tech.summary: An OpenAI safety employee has resigned and is publicly raising concerns about the company's approach to AI safety.
Apple is implementing new restrictions on "full disk access" permissions in macOS to mitigate potential risks posed by artificial intelligence agents.
Google has initiated Project Suncatcher, a long-term endeavor aimed at deploying AI data centers into space to leverage solar energy.

world.summary: Tens of thousands of people across Spain have protested against the country's housing crisis following the parliament's rejection of two affordable housing decrees.
Russia launched strikes against Kyiv, hitting a second major bridge in the Ukrainian capital, with five people reported killed in the exchange of strikes between Kyiv and Moscow.
The United Arab Emirates has stated that the Flydubai co-pilot's attack on the captain with an axe was an attempted "terrorist" act.

us.summary: A federal ban on hemp-derived THC products is set to take effect by year-end, which threatens to disrupt a multibillion-dollar market for low-dose THC drinks.
Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences museum, known for its dinosaur exhibits, has closed its doors permanently this week after nearly 200 years of operation.
California has enacted new legislation designed to protect workers from the potential negative impacts of artificial intelligence on employment.

science.summary: Metro Phoenix has reported a doubling of heat-related deaths compared to the same period last year, prompting authorities to investigate the reasons and potential interventions.
A new £2.3 million study will explore whether personalized pain management plans can improve the quality of life for millions of women suffering from endometriosis.
